{"action":"edit","path":"toolformer_filter.py","old_text":"","new_text":"import numpy as np


def filter_api_calls(with_result, call_only, no_call, tau_filter):
    """Implement Toolformer loss-filter.

    Inputs:
        with_result (np.ndarray): shape (n_candidates, future_horizon)
        call_only   (np.ndarray): shape (n_candidates, future_horizon)
        no_call     (np.ndarray): shape (n_candidates, future_horizon)
        tau_filter  (float): nonnegative threshold

    Returns:
        keep (np.ndarray[bool]): shape (n_candidates,)
        margins (np.ndarray[float]): shape (n_candidates,)

    Raises:
        ValueError: if any input is invalid.
    """
    # Validate inputs
    for name, arr in [('with_result', with_result),
                      ('call_only', call_only),
                      ('no_call', no_call)]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f'{name} must be a numpy array')
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f'{name} must be a 2D matrix')
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f'{name} is empty')
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f'{name} contains nonfinite values')
        if not np.all(arr <= 0):
            raise ValueError(f'{name} contains positive values')

    # Check consistent shapes
    if not (with_result.shape == call_only.shape == no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError('All input matrices must have the same shape')

    # Validate tau_filter
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError('tau_filter cannot be a boolean')
    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float, np.floating, np.integer)):
        raise ValueError('tau_filter must be a numeric type')
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
        raise ValueError('tau_filter must be finite')
    if tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError('tau_filter must be nonnegative')

    n = with_result.shape[0]
    # Compute loss as negative sum of log probabilities over the horizon
    loss_with = -np.sum(with_result, axis=1)
    loss_call = -np.sum(call_only, axis=1)
    loss_no = -np.sum(no_call, axis=1)

    # Margin = improvement with result over the best baseline
    margins = np.minimum(loss_no, loss_call) - loss_with
    keep = margins > tau_filter

    return keep, margins
